parameters.value: The cabinet door is made from mild steel or galvanized steel sheet of not less than 0.8 mm and not more than 2.5 mm nominal thickness and shall be firmly hinged to the cabinet by hinges in such a way that door can be opened upto 180 deg. The door of the fire resisting record protection cabinet shall be of double wall type with insulating material filled in- between. The insulating material should not produce toxic gases when the cabinet is exposed to fire situation. The components shall be assembled by bolting, welding, riveting or by any combination of these methods.

buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller,

if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 3. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK 1. OBJECTIVE 1.1 The Godrej Fire Resisting Record Cabinet (FRRC), 2-hour rating, is required to protect paper records, files, registers and important office documents against fire. 1.2 This Scope of Work defines the supply, delivery, installation, documentation and acceptance require ments for the cabinet. 2. SCOPE OF SUPPLY 2.1 The bidder shall supply the Godrej Fire Resisting Record Cabinet, Model FRRC 2 HR, in the quantity s tated in the bid / Schedule of Requirements, complete with adjustable shelves, the Godrej 6-lever d ual-control lock and all keys. 2.2 The brand shall be Godrej only. Any other brand, or any substitute model, will not be accepted. 2.3 The cabinet shall be new, unused and of current manufacture. 3. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS The cabinet shall conform to the following specifications. The technical data sheet of the Godrej FRRC 2 HR is attached for reference. Parameter Specification Product type Fire Resisting Record Cabinet (FRRC) Manufacturer / Brand Godrej only (no other brand acceptable) Model FRRC 2 HR Fire resistance rating 120 minutes (2 hours)

External dimensions (H x W x 1875 mm x 850 mm x 785 mm D) Internal dimensions (H x W x D 1620 mm x 670 mm x 585 mm ) Approximate weight 790 kg (some published sheets state 800 kg) Storage arrangement Adjustable internal shelves Locking arrangement Godrej 6-lever dual-control lock Additional locking (optional) 3-wheel combination lock; combination / electronic / bio metric lock as optional security Shooting bolts 3 on each side, 1 at top and 1 at bottom (multi-point sh ooting bolt arrangement) Cabinet body Double-wall steel construction Fire insulation Special inert fire-resistant in-fill material Door Multi-layer fire-resistant construction Door sealing Tongue-and-groove arrangement External finish Manufacturer's standard finish Note: The product literature mentions exposure temperatures of approximately 1000–1010°C. Actual perf ormance shall be established from the certified test report and not from temperature alone. 4. CONSTRUCTION FEATURES The cabinet shall have the following construction features: 4.1 Tongue-and-groove construction helps prevent hot gases from entering the storage compartment. 4.2 Special in-fill material provides thermal insulation. 4.3 In-fill construction helps protect the cabinet against falling debris. 4.4 Multiple shooting bolts provide additional locking security. 4.5 The cabinet is designed for fire endurance and fire impact protection. 5. TESTING AND CERTIFICATION The bidder shall obtain the following documents from Godrej and furnish them before purchase / along wit h the bid:

Requirement Details Fire endurance 2-hour test report Fire impact 2-hour test report BIS standard IS 14203, as referenced in the product literature Certification Valid BIS licence / applicable test certificate Test documentation Fire endurance and impact test reports 5.1The test reports shall relate to the model offered (FRRC 2 HR). The buyer reserves the right to verify the BIS licence and the test reports with the issuing authority. 6. DELIVERY AND INSTALLATION 6.1 Delivery location: 3rd Floor, MTNL Exchange Building, Curry Road, Mumbai. 6.2 A service lift is available at the building. Its weight limit is 700 kg. 6.3 The cabinet weighs approximately 790–800 kg, which is more than the service lift limit. The bidder s hall therefore inspect the site before delivery and submit a method statement for safe movement of the cabinet to the 3rd floor. The method statement shall cover the handling equipment and the arra ngement for staying within the lift limit, with the combined weight of cabinet, handling equipment a nd personnel in the lift counted against the 700 kg limit. 6.4 All transport, loading, unloading, hoisting, shifting, handling labour and equipment shall be arranged by the bidder at no extra cost to the buyer. 6.5 Any partial dismantling of the cabinet for transit, if required, shall be done only by Godrej-authorised personnel. The cabinet shall be reassembled and tested at site so that the fire-resistant construction and the locking arrangement are not compromised. 6.6 The bidder shall place the cabinet at the location shown by the buyer, check the lock and shooting b olt operation, and hand over all keys and the lock-operation instructions. 6.7 The bidder shall be responsible for any damage to the cabinet, the building, the lift or the floor durin g delivery and installation, and shall make good such damage at its own cost. 7. QUALITY AND ACCEPTANCE 7.1 The product quality shall meet the specifications given in this Scope of Work. 7.2 The buyer shall inspect the cabinet on delivery against the specifications, dimensions, brand, model and certification documents. 7.3 A cabinet that does not meet the specification shall be rejected and shall be removed and replaced b y the bidder at its own cost within the time the buyer specifies. 8. CANCELLATION 8.1 The buyer preserves the right to cancel this bid at any time without assigning any reason. 9. DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED BY THE BIDDER 9.1 Godrej technical data sheet / catalogue for FRRC 2 HR. 9.2 Valid BIS licence / test certificate and the 2-hour fire endurance and fire impact test reports (Para 5). 9.3 Method statement for delivery to the 3rd floor (Para 6.3). . 5. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product

during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 6. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c.
